items.title: Universal knowledge base
items.description: Every run creates a vendor-neutral .handover directory with architecture, decisions, constraints, tasks, milestones, prompts, and codebase indexing.

items.title: Agent-specific output
items.description: The same extracted context is rendered into the file layout expected by Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Aider, Goose, or all targets at once.

items.title: Incremental updates
items.description: Follow-up chats can be merged into an existing handoff without wiping completed tasks or manual edits.

items.title: Multiple source formats
items.description: Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity exports all normalize into the same project context model.

items.title: CLI-first workflow
items.description: Use dry-run previews, grouped conversation listing, merge-by-project, browser-extension capture, and MCP tooling from one open-source package.
